nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Pretrained normative models used Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping (sinarcsinsh).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: normative models were trained using Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping using sinarcsinsh function

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Three neuroimaging phenotypes were modeled: cortical thickness, cortical surface area, and subcortical volumes. Cortical measures were summarized using the Destrieux atlas parcellation scheme (148 ROIs). Subcortical volume segmentation was based on a probabilistic atlas with priors for 31 brain structures using Freesurfer v7.1.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The dependent variable was set to the ROI values of volume, area, or thickness [...] Freesurfer v7.1 was used to process data that passed quality control. Cortical thickness and area was summarized using the Destrieux atlas parcellation scheme. Subcortical volume segmentation was based on a probabilistic atlas with priors for 31 brain structures.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative models used age and scanner as independent variables (predictors). The pretrained models were based on data from 82 sites and an additional harmonization step was implemented using a calibration set of 998 healthy controls to fine-tune model parameters for the unseen scanner sites in this study.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: The dependent variable was set to the ROI values of volume, area, or thickness, while the independent variables were age and scanner. [...] To account for the absence of scanner data used to acquire data in the model, an additional harmonization step was implemented. An unmatched group of healthy controls (n = 998) was utilized to fine-tune model parameters, enabling the application of normative models to unseen sites.
